title: Block: Form card

fields.label: Form
fields.name: form
fields.instructions: The Contact Form 7 form to show. Its fields, labels, consent text and e-mails are edited in Contact → Contact Forms. Keep the production form IDs (analytics reads them, DESIGN.md "Forms").

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: heading
fields.instructions: Optional section heading (h2), as on production, e.g. «Jetzt anfragen».

fields.label: Show contacts
fields.name: show_contacts
fields.instructions: E-mail, phone and address from Site Settings next to the form (from 64rem; below it on phones). Off in the narrow landing column.

fields.label: Background
fields.name: background
fields.instructions: Section background: alternate with the neighbouring sections; yellow only for short sections, at most one per screen (DESIGN.md, Sections). The form itself stays on its light card.

description: Fields for the form card block (blocks/text/form-card.php).
